note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Both scenes share the same supplied route, points, review desk, filter doors (only routes.returnTo stands open), folder and calendar; the ONE changed fact is how the folder reaches the configured point: A (initial examination) enters from the left with no notes, B (renewed examination) comes back from the review desk with the supplied notes. Neither scene shows a result: the renewed examination is not shown and has no outcome; no winner, score or conclusion is drawn. Brief fields: decisions, grounds (B's notes), routes, outcomes, scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts and comparisonLabels are editable.
